whatOccurred: Employee operated the excavator without a spotter present near an active utility trench, in violation of the site traffic control plan.
earlierWarnings: Verbal warning given on 2026-06-14 for a similar spotter-related concern.
companyPolicyStates: All heavy equipment operation near excavations must use a dedicated spotter per the Shackelford Safety Manual, Section on Heavy Equipment.
employeeStatement: Employee stated the spotter had stepped away briefly and he did not stop work to wait for them to return.
correctiveActionRequired: Employee must stop and wait for a spotter to be present before resuming excavation-adjacent equipment work, every time, no exceptions.
companyWill: The company will retrain the employee on spotter requirements and monitor compliance for the next 30 days.
ifNotCorrected: Continued violations will result in further disciplinary action up to and including termination.
